background: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is one of Canada's big six banks, funded by Canadian deposits and lending mainly on Canadian mortgages and to businesses, with a US commercial and wealth arm and a Caribbean bank.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook; the last move was a three-notch downgrade by one of the three on 11 Jul 2024. Capital is middling for Canadian banks, CET1 of 13.4% just below the peer median and leverage of 4.3% in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 31 Jul 2026. The site holds no liquidity ratios for the bank, so the view rests on capital and ratings.
